title: Moi Moi (Steamed Bean Pudding)
summary: Skinned black-eyed peas blended with red pepper, onion, Scotch bonnet and stock, then steamed in ramekins with egg.
equipment: wide pan with lid and a rack or folded cloth

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
vegetable oil, plus extra for greasing

steps.title: Soak
steps.text: Cover the peas with water and soak 30-60 min.

steps.title: Skin
steps.text: Pulse the peas with fresh water in the blender in short bursts just to crack them, tip into the bowl, swish and pour off the floating skins; repeat until almost all are skinless.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend the skinned peas with the onion, pepper, chilli, stock and salt 3-4 min until completely smooth, then whisk in the oil.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Grease the ramekins, half-fill with batter, add a piece of egg to each, top up and cover tightly with foil.

steps.title: Steam
steps.text: Set on the rack in the pan with 2 cm simmering water, cover and steam 45-60 min, topping up the water, until firm, a skewer comes out clean and the centre reads at least 74 °C.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Rest 5 min, then turn out or serve in the ramekins.

tips: Take the time to remove the bean skins; left in, they make the pudding grey and gritty.
Blend until there is no grit at all for a silky texture.
Do not let the steaming pan boil dry.
safety: Wear gloves when handling Scotch bonnet.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 3 days; re-steam until piping hot. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
